006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.util.regex.Pattern;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.MarkupMultiline;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
012import dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint.impl.DefaultKeyField;
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
015
016/**
017 * Represents a component of a key used in a key-based index.
018 * <p>
019 * A key field is targeted at a Metaschema field or flag data object's value. An
020 * optional pattern can be used to extract a portion of the value for use in
021 * generating an index key.
022 */
023public interface IKeyField {
024  /**
025   * Construct a new key field based on the provided target. An optional pattern
026   * can be used to extract a portion of the resulting key value.
027   *
028   * @param target
029   *          a Metapath expression identifying the target of the key field
030   * @param pattern
031   *          an optional used to extract a portion of the resulting key value
032   * @param remarks
033   *          optional remarks describing the intent of the constraint
034   * @return the new key field
035   */
036  @NonNull
037  static IKeyField of(
038      @NonNull IMetapathExpression target,
039      @Nullable Pattern pattern,
040      @Nullable MarkupMultiline remarks) {
041    return new DefaultKeyField(target, pattern, remarks);
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Get the Metapath expression that identifies the node item whose value will be
046   * used as the key value.
047   *
048   * @return the Metapath expression identifying the key value target
049   */
050  @NonNull
051  IMetapathExpression getTarget();
052
053  /**
054   * A pattern to use to retrieve the value. If non-{@code null}, the first
055   * capturing group is used to retrieve the value.
056   *
057   * @return a pattern to use to get the value or {@code null} if the full value
058   *         is to be used
059   */
060  @Nullable
061  Pattern getPattern();
062
063  /**
064   * Any remarks about the key field as markup text.
065   *
066   * @return markup text or {@code null} if no text is provided
067   */
068  @Nullable
069  MarkupMultiline getRemarks();
070}
